title: Funds sought to clear traffic gridlocks on Alinchuvadu-Vennala-Eroor road in Keralam’s Kochi
description: Motorists, residents’ and merchants’ bodies have been demanding steps to clear traffic bottlenecks on the stretch that runs parallel to the Palarivattom-Kundannur NH bypass, considering the immense potential the road holds to decongest the bypass. On widening Vennala Junction, Uma Thomas, MLA, says apart from widening the junction’s bell mouth, land might have to be acquired at approximately one metre width from either side of the junction to ensure smooth flow of traffic
